label: PU §201: there is a way of grasping a rule which is not an INTERPRETATION_1, but which is exhibited…
paraphrase: PU §201: there is a way of grasping a rule which is not an interpretation, but which is exhibited, case by case, in what we call following the rule and going against it; 'interpretation' should be used only for substituting one expression of the rule for another. Not formalized: its Lean shadow would be the denial of STMT-RULE-DETERMINED-ONLY-THROUGH-INTERPRETATION.
